eoSetupLede.message: Profile cookies are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. The key is derived from your passphrase via PBKDF2 (600,000 iterations). The passphrase is never stored and never leaves this device.

eoWarnForget.message: If you forget the passphrase, your profiles are unrecoverable. There is no reset link.

eoWarnReenter.message: You will re-enter the passphrase once per browser session.

eoTooManyAttempts.message: Too many wrong attempts. Wait for the lockout to expire.

eoLockedOut60.message: Wrong passphrase — locked out for 60 seconds.

eoWrongPassAttempts.message: Wrong passphrase. $1 attempts left before lockout.

eoResetMessage.message: This permanently destroys all saved profiles. There is no undo and no reset link — they cannot be recovered.

eoScopeLede.message: Profiles operate on a fixed set of host suffixes. Switching a profile only touches cookies that match this scope — other sites stay untouched.

eoLiveCount.message: $1 live $2 cookies in this browser right now

eoSafety1.message: Only use profiles for accounts you own or are authorised to test. Re-using session cookies on accounts you don't control is a Terms-of-Service violation on most sites and may be illegal.

eoSafety2.message: The browser must refresh open $1 tabs to pick up the new cookies. Cookies attached to long-lived WebSocket / SSE connections may persist until the page reloads.

eoSafety3.message: Some sites bind session cookies to other signals (device fingerprint, IP). Switching cookies alone may trigger a re-login or a security challenge — that is the site's risk control, not a bug in CookieVault.
